posts.title: Stochastic Geomophical Transport for Terrain Erosion Simulation
posts.description: One major way to model terrain has been through simulating erosion: how the rock weathers away is a big component of the vibe of the landscape on a geological scale. But there’s a couple of components to that: both the erosion itself and also where that material goes afterwards.
